scope: TRAIN authors only for every feature, fit, topic and model-choice diagnostic; val/test metadata counts only
model: LogisticRegression C=1, lbfgs, max_iter=3000; no search
cv: StratifiedGroupKFold; at most five folds, minimum distinct groups/author; same folds for all methods; five seeds
groups: same article/text or TRAIN-only word-5-shingle Jaccard>=0.80 or word-TFIDF cosine>=0.95; graph connected components
paired_primary: Fit each method on all TRAIN originals excluding every group represented in the fixed 30 pairs. Predict unseen Original and corresponding ChatGPT Rewrite using precisely the same fitted model.
paired_secondary: Repeat fixed-30 comparison after stratified 80% resampling of training pool by author; five seeds. Also eligible-only pool as prespecified sensitivity.
feature_scaling: fit on each fit portion only
topic_audit: TRAIN-only word unigram TFIDF and KMeans(k=6,n_init=10,random_state=42); exploratory cluster-author NMI, not topic labels or causal shortcut proof
paired_inference: two-sided exact McNemar via binomial test, Holm over four primary all-TRAIN methods; paired accuracy cluster bootstrap by author, 2000 draws seed 20261108
selection: All 30 pairs regardless of guard/review; no filtering by external clean status
syntax: No English parser model installed at feasibility; sentence structure metrics are proxies, not syntactic analysis
